OAT-03/S09.detail: Code read (review of TFA-94422): a Haiku attempt that hangs is cut at 20 s (attemptTimeout(0) = min(20 s, 30 s budget)); the SDK AbortError is a temporary failure; because Haiku took 10 s or more to fail, it is not asked again and Mistral is called at once with attemptTimeout(20 s) = max(8 s, min(20 s, 10 s)) = 10 s. Each vendor attempt runs inside timeProviderCall, so the hung 20 s count in providerMs and the 1 s retry pause (not taken here) would not; answeredBy records model = Mistral and fellBackFrom = Haiku. So the judged rules hold in the code: model Mistral, fellBackFrom Haiku, providerMs ≥ 20000, durationMs − providerMs small. Recorded, not judged: no second Haiku try (UAT step 6 says retry; Q4) and only 10 s left for Mistral (Q14). The runtime half needs Haiku made to hang: an in-process Bedrock stub as in TC-10/S27 (about 40 min, no model) or Quinn approving a private local backend.
